strings.no_moves_help: Use Undo or Shuffle to keep playing.
strings.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
strings.error_content: The puzzles couldn't be loaded. Please try again.
strings.error_level_unavailable: That puzzle isn't available. Taking you home.
strings.save_recovered: Your progress was restored from a backup.
strings.all_levels_done: Every level completed - replay any you like!
strings.all_discoveries_found: Every discovery found. Thank you for playing!
strings.tile_blocked_help: That tile is blocked. A free tile has nothing on top and an open left or right side.
strings.hint_unverified: Here's a matching pair. There wasn't time to check further ahead.
strings.hint_dead: No pair here can still clear the board. Try Undo or Shuffle - both are free.
strings.stuck_banner: This board can't be finished from here. Undo or Shuffle to continue.
strings.rescue_body: Shuffle rearranges the remaining tiles into a layout that can be solved. It's always free.
strings.shuffle_failed_body: The remaining tiles are stacked so that no arrangement can be cleared. You can go back to the last solvable point or restart - both are free.
strings.rewind_checkpoint: Go back to last solvable point
strings.restart_confirm_body: The current board starts over. Your completed levels and Lights are kept.
strings.replay_no_light: Replays are just for fun - Lights come from new boards.

lights_to_next.one: {count} more Light to your next discovery
lights_to_next.other: {count} more Lights to your next discovery

strings.ad_bonus_light: Watch a short video: bonus Light
strings.world_locked_hint: Complete level {level} to open this world.
strings.bloom_tap_hint: Tap a discovery to learn its story.

daily_archive_note.one: Puzzles from the last {count} day stay playable. There are no streaks - play whenever you like.
daily_archive_note.other: Puzzles from the last {count} days stay playable. There are no streaks - play whenever you like.

strings.tasks_claim_locked: Finish all three to claim today's Light.
strings.tasks_no_pressure: Optional. Missed days are fine - nothing resets.
strings.shop_unavailable: The shop isn't available in this version.
strings.shop_error: The store can't be reached right now. Please try again later.
strings.shop_free_promise: Every level, Hint, Undo and Shuffle is free. Purchases are optional cosmetics only.
strings.restore_unavailable: Purchases aren't available in this version, so there is nothing to restore.
strings.product_remove_ads_desc: Turns off all optional ad breaks. Never affects gameplay.
strings.product_theme_bundle_desc: Unlocks the Sakura, Ocean and Nocturne tile themes right away.
strings.purchase_success_body: Your purchase is ready to enjoy.
strings.purchase_pending_body: Your payment is being processed. The item will unlock once the store confirms it.
strings.purchase_failed_body: No charge was made by the game. Please try again later.
strings.vibration_note: Vibration works on phones and tablets.
strings.graphics_note: Low uses lighter backgrounds and fewer effects to save battery.
strings.large_tiles_note: Keeps tiles big on large boards; drag to move around the board.
strings.highlight_free_note: Tiles you can't pick yet are shown slightly darker.
strings.show_timer_note: A personal statistic only. Time never affects anything.
strings.link_not_configured_note: This link will be added before release.
strings.analytics_note_off: This version doesn't collect any usage statistics.
strings.analytics_note_on: Optional. Helps us improve puzzles. You can change this anytime.
strings.reset_progress_note: Erases progress stored on this device. Store purchases are not affected and can be restored.
strings.reset_confirm_body: Completed levels, Lights, discoveries and daily records on this device will be erased. This can't be undone.
strings.licenses_body: Game art, sounds and puzzles were created originally for Veya Mahjong. Rubik font: SIL Open Font License 1.1, The Rubik Project Authors. Built with the Godot Engine (MIT license).
strings.tut_step_match: Tap two matching tiles to clear them. Try the glowing pair!
strings.tut_step_sides: A tile is free when its left or right side is open. The middle tiles are blocked - clear the outer pair first.
strings.tut_step_stack: Tiles underneath are blocked until the tiles on top are cleared. Start with the top layer.
strings.tut_step_bonus: Any Flower matches any Flower, and any Season matches any Season.
strings.tut_ready: You're ready! Hint, Undo and Shuffle are always free - take your time.
strings.story_stone_path: Smooth stones invite slow, unhurried walks.
strings.story_flower_bed: Every bloom here opened after a quiet match.
strings.story_sakura_tree: Its petals fall whenever someone smiles nearby.
strings.story_pond: The pond reflects the sky, and your calm.
strings.story_stone_lantern: It glows softly when the garden needs it.
strings.story_butterfly: A visitor that only stays where it feels peaceful.
strings.story_blossom_pink: Pink blossoms for every gentle morning.
strings.story_wooden_fence: Not to keep anyone out - just to lean on.
strings.story_bridge: A small bridge for small, happy steps.
strings.story_pagoda: A place to rest between puzzles.
strings.story_shell: Hold it close and you'll hear the waves.
strings.story_rocks: Polished by a thousand patient tides.
strings.story_coral: Coral grows slowly and beautifully, like good habits.
strings.story_pearl: A treasure formed by time and care.
strings.story_grass_patch: The breeze plays here all afternoon.
strings.story_shrub: A cozy hideaway for sea birds.
strings.story_leaf_tree: Its shade makes the sunniest day gentle.
strings.story_lotus: It rises from still water, bright and calm.
strings.story_blossom_white: White blossoms, light as sea foam.
strings.story_lantern: A warm light for a peaceful night.
strings.story_crystal_cluster: The crystals hum softly under the moon.
strings.story_blossom_blue: Blue blossoms open only after dusk.
strings.story_maple_tree: Its leaves glow like embers in the moonlight.
strings.story_cherry_petals: Petals drift on the night air like quiet wishes.
strings.story_pagoda_night: Its windows glow for every traveller.
